A
major
inhabitant
of
the
rocky
intertidal
zone
of
Monterey
Bay ,
the
mussel

Mytilus
californianus
feeds
by
filtering
water
through

These

and
anthropogenic

( xenobiotics )
which

the
mussels
ingest
through
their
diet
or
absorb

from
the
water .
An

understanding
of
how

From
this
research
there

significant
evidence

the

environment

human

protection
by
pumping
toxins
out

cell .
